scripts.build: npm run frontend:build && npm run api:build
scripts.deploy: npm run api:deploy && npm run frontend:deploy
scripts.frontend:build: cd udagram/udagram-frontend && node ../../scripts/node-compat.js npx ng build --prod
scripts.frontend:test: cd udagram/udagram-frontend && node ../../scripts/node-compat.js npx ng test --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadlessNoSandbox
